method: Standalone standard-library arithmetic over raw JSONL/CSV/controller snapshots; no adapter/core imports or execution, no models/tests/live queries.
known_nonblocking_observations: PID read_bytes is process storage accounting for all q4t file reads, not expert-only SSD bytes; rchar is logical read volume, not physical I/O.
Cgroup io.stat parent259:0 and global model partition259:1 represent different scopes. Their divergence/plateaus are observations, not zero I/O; never add PID/cgroup/device or parent+partition.
Group PID/cgroup sums cover disjoint client envelopes only. The partition group bound spans first-to-last client including gaps; the scopes are explicitly different and partition includes background.
Quality has11 requests in one batch envelope: no per-question I/O attribution. The remaining78 envelopes are serial clients, including launch/teardown; no pure prefill/decode split.
Per-bucket memory peaks use complete resource windows inside the client envelope and may miss boundary/intersample peaks. NVIDIA uses fresh complete observation windows only.

Sampled memory.current and retained memory.peak are distinct non-atomic counter observations. History sampled current exceeds retained peak with the same cgroup identity; values are retained and cause is unproven.
Quality MemoryMax=max; four performance groups configure16GiB and expose small recorded excesses and nonzero memory.events.max, with observed OOM/oom_kill/swap zero. These are not whole-RAM caps.
NVIDIA/RSS/PSS/cgroup/file cache views overlap and independent maxima occur at different times. They are never summed; sampled NVIDIA56237228032B is not physical-union proof.
PSI is missing; live model cache is deliberately not sampled. Two cache endpoints and sidecar digests cannot establish live cache peak. Per-file cache sidecars were not independently recomputed.

One inheritance-on shutdown PID I/O observation is unknown; all selected client-envelope counter comparisons remain independently valid. Scheduled GPU blanks are unknown intervals, not carried-forward values.
Off then on, three repeats, cache history and client/logging work limit causal attribution. Resource changes are descriptive and cannot overturn the permanent performance NO_GO.
Whole physicalRAM54GB remains INDETERMINATE. The offline protection-v1 visibility failure and successful v2 repair are separate from runtime/resource failures.

Non-PSI cgroup unavailable observations are pre-service before_start entries: two rows in quality and one in each other group. Raw overall missingness counts were independently recomputed; original audit phase-group labels are explicitly identified in the summary.
protection_audit_note: Original offline exe visibility failure is preserved separately and repaired by reviewed v2; no runtime request repeated and no runtime failure inferred.
scope_exclusions: No full per-file cache sidecar recomputation
